summary: Verify Applications grid opens from the home screen
description: Regression test confirming the app-grid launcher icon on the home screen opens the Applications grid, using an image-based locator since the icon has no accessibility text.
preconditions: Device/emulator is powered on and unlocked
Home screen is the active screen
Reference template 'apps_grid_icon' has been captured via capture-template

testSteps.expectedResult: Applications grid opens showing installed app icons
